text.description_html:
LCN 4642 Electric Door Closer / Opener

LCN 4642 (AUTO EQUALIZER) is LCN’s new smart electrically powered low-energy power operator. It provides easy access for people with disabilities, the elderly, or the frail. Designed primarily for manual opening applications that occasionally require automatic opening via electric motor.

The LCN 4642 is UL and cUL listed with regular arm for self-closing doors and meets the provisions of ANSI Standards A117.1, A156.19, and the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).

The LCN 4642 has easily accessible switches to provide on/off and continuous hold open functions. Control module provides all timing and sequential door functions, electric strike controls and adjustments for opening speed and force.

Specifications and Features: of LCN 4642 Electric Door Closer / Opener

  • Maximum Door Weight: 250 lbs
  • Maximum Door Size: 36" - 54" Interior / 36" - 42" Exterior
  • Non-Handed
  • Grade 1 (Highest Grade)
  • UL 10C Approved
  • Spring Size: Adjustable 3-5
  • Standard with Cover
  • NEW Digital Control Suite
  • Utilizes a 10,000,000 Cycle Heavy Duty Door Closer
  • On-Board Diagnostics
  • On-Board Power Supply
  • Factory-Default Memory
  • Plug-and-Play Connections
  • No Destruct Feature
  • No Guard Rails or Safety Mats Required
  • ADA Compliant
  • Aluminum Finish
  • Mounts on Push Side of Door
  • 2 Year Warranty
  • LCN 4642 Specifications (PDF).
